items.title: Save TikTok and Instagram recipes
items.text: Share a TikTok, an Instagram Reel, a Facebook video or a Pinterest pin to Pinch, or paste the link yourself.

items.title: YouTube video to recipe
items.text: Get the ingredients and steps written out. No more pausing and rewinding.

items.title: The whole recipe, every time
items.text: Even when the amounts are only said out loud or flashed on screen, Pinch writes them down.

items.title: Websites and cookbooks too
items.text: Paste a recipe website link, snap a cookbook page or a handwritten card, or add a PDF.

items.title: Recipes from your WhatsApp chats
items.text: Bring in the links, written recipes and photos your family shared in a group chat, all at once.

items.title: Plan your week
items.text: Pinch fills breakfast, lunch and dinner around your diet and what's at home. Free, and one tap sends it to your list.

items.title: A shopping list that knows your pantry
items.text: Ingredients from several recipes stack into one line, grouped by aisle. What you already have stays off.

items.title: Shop together
items.text: Share one shopping list and pantry with the people you live with. Everyone sees changes as they happen.

items.title: What can I cook tonight?
items.text: Snap your fridge and cupboards, and Pinch ranks the recipes you saved by what you already have.

items.title: Cook along
items.text: Keep the source video beside the steps, or cook step by step with timers and the steps read aloud.

items.title: Make it yours
items.text: Remix any recipe (healthier, vegetarian, gluten-free, and more), swap an ingredient, scale servings, or translate it.

items.title: Your recipe library
items.text: Keep every saved recipe in one place, group them into collections, or turn them into a PDF cookbook.

steps.text: Tap Share on a TikTok, Instagram Reel, or YouTube video and pick Pinch. Or copy the link and paste it in.

guides.ctaTitle: Save your next recipe with Pinch
guides.ctaSub: 10 free recipe credits every month. No subscription, and extra credits never expire.

items.a: Pinch turns a cooking video from TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube into a written recipe: ingredients, steps, and a shopping list you can check off at the store. It also plans your week around your diet and keeps track of what's already in your pantry.

items.q: Is this the same as other apps called Pinch?
items.a: No. This is Pinch: Recipe Library, the app at pinch-app.io, on the App Store and Google Play. It isn't related to other apps or sites with Pinch in the name, such as getpinch.io or the Pinch It! Recipe Box app.

items.q: Can Pinch turn a YouTube video into a recipe?
items.a: Yes. Paste a YouTube link and Pinch writes out the ingredients and steps, so you don't have to pause and rewind while you cook.

items.q: How do I save a recipe from TikTok or Instagram?
items.a: Tap Share on the video and pick Pinch, or copy the link and paste it into Pinch. The recipe goes straight into your Library as soon as it's ready.

items.q: Does Pinch work with Pinterest and Facebook?
items.a: Yes. Paste a Pinterest pin or a public Facebook reel or post, or share it to Pinch. When a pin links to a recipe website, Pinch reads the recipe from that site.

items.q: Can Pinch plan my meals for the week?
items.a: Yes. Tap Plan my week and Pinch fills breakfast, lunch and dinner from your saved recipes and the Cooking Hub, following your diet and leaving out your allergies. Planning is free. Send to list puts what you need on your shopping list and leaves off what you already have.

items.q: Can I share my shopping list with my family?
items.a: Yes. Set up a household in Settings and invite the people you live with by link or QR code. You share one shopping list and one pantry, and everyone sees changes as they happen. Recipes and credits stay yours. A household can have up to 8 people.

items.q: Can I import recipes from a WhatsApp chat?
items.a: Yes. Export the chat from WhatsApp and choose it in Pinch. Pinch reads the chat on your device, lists the links, written recipes and photos it finds, and imports only the ones you pick, one credit each.
Yes. A free account includes 10 recipe credits every month. If you need more, you can buy recipe credits in the app. They never expire, and there's no subscription.

items.q: Can I use Pinch without the app?
items.a: Yes. Pinch also runs in your browser at [pinch-app.io/app](/app/). Your library syncs when you sign in with the same account.

items.q: Can I move my recipes from another app?
items.a: Yes, one recipe at a time. Paste the original link, from a website or a video, and Pinch saves it to your Library.
Pinch is available in English, Spanish, Hebrew, Arabic, and Russian.
No. Pinch doesn't sell your personal information. The services that help run Pinch, like the AI that writes out your recipes, only process it to operate Pinch.
